Frontend Developer (React)

About the team
Our product team builds accessible tools for clinics. Score yourself honestly
against the list below; we value growth over perfection.

Responsibilities
- Build accessible React and TypeScript interfaces.
- Work with designers in Figma and write end-to-end tests with Playwright.

Must have
- 3+ years of React and TypeScript.
- Strong CSS and accessibility (WCAG 2.1) knowledge.

Nice to have
- Next.js, design systems, healthcare experience.
